story.title: Congress wants to tighten export rules on AI chips after Nvidia spy scandal
story.summary: Unsurprisingly, following the scandal involving now-former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a suspected Chinese spy, Congress is looking to further restrict exports of AI chips. linkedin.title: We are moving from searching for links to searching for answers.
linkedin.body:
For decades, the internet taught us to be good librarians. We typed a query, scanned a list of blue links, and played detective to figure out which source was actually telling the truth. It was a chore, and it took a lot of time.

AI search changes the dynamic completely. Instead of sending you on a scavenger hunt, it summarizes the consensus across multiple reputable sources. It turns the process from gathering information into understanding a topic.

But there is a catch. When you remove the friction of searching, you also remove the context of who reported what. You get the answer, but you might lose the nuance or the specific perspective that a particular journalist brought to the story.

That is exactly why we built Headlinne. We believe AI should act as a bridge to quality journalism rather than a replacement for it. The goal is to give you the speed of an AI summary while keeping you connected to the original reporting that matters.

It is about spending less time hunting for news and more time actually understanding it.

beats.caption: Estonia to close all border crossings with Russia after attack on drone maker
Estonia is shutting down all crossings.
beats.narration: We treat borders like simple lines on a map. But Estonia just closed its entire border with Russia.

beats.caption: A drone factory was deliberately attacked.
beats.narration: This follows a targeted sabotage attack on a drone maker inside the country over the weekend.

beats.caption: Authorities link the attack to Russian intelligence.
beats.detail: Investigators found clear evidence of coordination.
beats.narration: Estonian authorities say the attack was ordered by Russian intelligence services to disrupt local operations.

beats.caption: The sequence of events is clear.
beats.narration: One event triggered a security review, leading to this total border closure.

beats.caption: All border crossings close December 1.
beats.narration: Starting December 1, no one will be able to cross between the two nations.

beats.caption: Tensions rise over support for Ukraine.
beats.narration: The Estonian Prime Minister links this hostility directly to the country's ongoing support for Ukraine.

story_card.headline: UK to seek input on EU food rules
story_card.standfirst: The government is negotiating a new deal to influence European food standards after

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: The UK is negotiating a new deal to have a say on EU food rules despite leaving the bloc.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Since Brexit, the UK has been excluded from the decision-making process for food regulations.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: EU minister Hamish Falconer says this arrangement would give Britain influence on policy.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Look for the final terms of this deal to see how much actual sway the UK keeps over rules.

story_card.caption:
The UK is negotiating for a voice on EU food rules in a post Brexit reset.

Minister Hamish Falconer claims this new deal will allow Britain to influence policy even without a vote. It is a significant attempt to regain some control over standards that affect trade and food safety.
